intro: The Ottoman kitchen bridging Europe and Asia: kebabs, flatbreads, yoghurt, spiced lamb and syrupy pastries.
flavours: Lamb, yoghurt, sumac, pul biber (chilli flakes), mint, pistachio

dishes.name: Döner kebab
dishes.what: Seasoned meat roasted on a vertical spit, shaved into bread or onto rice.

dishes.name: İskender kebap
dishes.what: Bursa speciality: döner slices over bread with tomato sauce, yoghurt and sizzling butter.

dishes.name: Adana kebab
dishes.what: Long hand-minced lamb kebab with chilli, grilled on a wide flat skewer.

dishes.name: Lahmacun
dishes.what: Very thin, crisp flatbread topped with spiced minced meat; roll it up with parsley and lemon.

dishes.name: Pide
dishes.what: Boat-shaped flatbread with fillings like cheese, egg or meat.

dishes.name: Mantı
dishes.what: Tiny meat dumplings under garlic yoghurt and chilli butter.

dishes.name: Menemen
dishes.what: Breakfast of eggs scrambled softly into tomatoes and peppers.

dishes.name: Baklava
dishes.what: Layers of filo with chopped nuts, soaked in syrup. Gaziantep pistachio is the gold standard.

dishes.name: Turkish delight
dishes.what: Soft, chewy cubes of starch and sugar flavoured with rose or citrus, dusted with icing sugar.
